items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Joe Beck played guitar with them somewhere in that period on and off.

ctx.x: I think that was before Lew. It’s really close. Joe Beck played guitar with them somewhere in that period on and off. Joe was having a lot of trouble with his eyes so sometimes he just didn’t want to make club dates. But Billy Harper, Trevor Kohler, it goes on. But there were a lot of really strong soloists. And guys would stand up and take twenty choruses and it would be worth it. It was great. So I’m sitting there as a horn player and this went on for a while. And we’d play a head and then there would be twenty…
Do you still play the horn?
